[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Rhoda was born in 1832. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-835|Robert Glasgow]]. She passed away in 1868.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-835]] is assessed at 73% (probable). The held family account identifies Rhoda Montgomery (Glasgow) Fulton as Robert Barclay Glasgow’s child, generally with Phebe McFall. Rhoda’s stated 1832 birth conflicts with memorial 1823, when Robert was18; this is a real identity/date issue requiring reconciliation.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the child’s earliest household and the cited Faris page or original gravestone parent inscription.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2222 Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), p.88]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.

=== Father relationship: Faris family review — 24 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-835|Robert Barclay Glasgow]] is now assessed at 85% (probable), up from 73% on 22 October 2026. This review supersedes the earlier father grade above.

The printed list names Rhoda Montgomery, born 31 July 1832, and husband James Fisher Fulton, matching the selected account’s names, full birth date and linked James Fulton. These combined identifiers strengthen the existing Robert father proposal. The actual Faris pp. 46–47 were visually checked. They explicitly group these children under Robert Barclay Glasgow and Phoebe McFall; Robert’s own dates, two wives and Ohio–Iowa life identify the father account. These exact percentages are subjective assessments of each complete father/profile pair, not statistical measurements.<ref name="FarisRobertChildren1990">David Faris, ''The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio'' (Baltimore: Gateway Press,1990), [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS3J-H9F6-3 printed pp. 46–47], DGS 007834162,image 1583; actual printed pages visually checked 24 October 2026. Retrospective genealogy; original family and census records not inspected. The Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns the previous generation and is not asserted for this child list.</ref>

The held memorial citation instead gives Rhoda M. Fulton as 1823–1868. That nine-year disagreement is material: neither birth year nor adult/memorial identity has been resolved. Retain probable 85%, not a confident attachment, and inspect the memorial or age-bearing census next. No birth or death field changes. This is one retrospective compiled family history. Its list, reported censuses, modern family fields and memorial citations may share evidence; repeated details are not independent proofs. No original birth register, census, Bible or burial record was newly inspected. The 1927 Bible provenance on p. 32 concerns William and Rhoda’s children, not the dates of Robert’s next generation; it is not transferred here. Existing named fathers remain selected. Mothers are separate, ungraded or unselected where previously so. No new parent attachment, merge or live save.
